feedback: The investigation was straightforward once the latency origin was traced through span trees. The traces_latency_origin tool was slightly misleading (pointed to checkout with 73ms self-time rather than frontend-proxy with 4s egress), but traces_slowest_operations and span tree inspection made it clear. The investigate_change tool was excellent for confirming/ruling out candidates with content-based reasoning. The main challenge was that this is a latency-only incident with zero errors, so error-focused tools were dead ends. The correlate_onset_consensus fell back to log-based onset at 470 which was inaccurate - the alert-based 360 was correct.
